verdict.rationale: Orb ships some recurring, schedule-driven automation within its billing domain — managed daily data exports (orb-docs-12), automatic dunning retries at fixed day offsets (orb-docs-19/33), and automatic invoice issuance after grace periods (orb-docs-21) — which are recurring jobs, but these are fixed, domain-specific billing processes rather than a general-purpose recurring workflow/job scheduler that an AI-native user could configure arbitrarily. Missing for 10: a user-configurable cron-like scheduler for arbitrary custom jobs/workflows, API/SDK support for defining or managing schedules programmatically, and independent evidence of this capability in practice.
